page.layout: One text column at left with a running head and page number at the top. Top: continuation paragraph from the previous page, ending with citations. A horizontal rule follows. Below it: centred title block, a centred section numeral, then the opening paragraph with a decorated initial. Bottom left: signature. Bottom right: catchword. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: dem loco adhuc repertum occidat. Metus ibi quippe periculi, atque mortis, qui in constantem virum caderet. Arg. l. 8. s.pen. D. quod met. cauf. l. 28. Cod. de Testam. l. unic. Cod. quand. lis. unicuique. Boër. decis. 168. num. 7.
main_text.head: Disputatio Juridica, Adl.2.Cod.leg.Cornel. DE SICARIIS, TERTIA. Resp. JACOBO CHATVELT, Heusdano.
main_text.p: QUod si dicatur defensio facta in continenti, probanda per eum, qui id asserit. l. 2. D de Probat: l. 23. Cod. eod. In dubio tamen, in continenti facta praesumetur esse defensio.

page.notes: The title block is set in mixed type sizes (small caps, letterspaced capitals, black-letter-like name line); it is given as one level 1 head. "TERTIA" is read as division number 3. The large decorated initial "Q" is joined to "Uod". "lis." in the citation "Cod. quand. lis. unicuique" is uncertain in the scan but was copied as printed. "Probat:" is printed with a colon. The top continuation paragraph is cut off at the top of the page.
